pairs.fr: Qu'est-ce que le coaching commercial par IA ?
pairs.en: What is AI sales coaching?

pairs.fr: Le coaching commercial par IA analyse les vraies conversations de vente […] qui installe des réflexes durables.
pairs.en: AI sales coaching analyzes your real sales conversations and gives every rep personalized feedback, automatically, after every call. Instead of waiting for an occasional debrief with their manager, each rep gets continuous, data-driven coaching that builds lasting habits.

pairs.fr: En quoi le coaching IA se distingue-t-il de la conversation intelligence ?
pairs.en: How is AI coaching different from conversation intelligence?

pairs.fr: Les outils de conversation intelligence sont descriptifs […] il analyse et il agit.
pairs.en: Conversation intelligence tools are descriptive: they tell you what happened. AI coaching is prescriptive: it tells reps what to do differently and lets them practice before the next call. Eagr does both. It analyzes, then it acts.

pairs.fr: Le Live Coach est-il source de distraction ?
pairs.en: Will Live Coach distract my reps?

pairs.fr: Il est conçu pour ne pas l’être. […] pas une machine à pop-ups.
pairs.en: It’s built not to. Live Coach only shows suggestions that matter, short and in context, and stays collapsed until it’s needed. A discreet copilot, not a pop-up machine.

pairs.fr: Qu'est-ce qu'un playbook dynamique ?
pairs.en: What is a dynamic playbook?

pairs.fr: Un playbook dynamique évolue automatiquement […] exercices de coaching ciblés.
pairs.en: A dynamic playbook evolves with what actually works on your team’s calls. Instead of a static doc nobody reads, Eagr spots winning behaviors, formalizes them and rolls them out to the whole team: Live Coach suggestions during calls, structured analysis after every call, and targeted coaching exercises.

pairs.fr: En combien de temps peut-on démarrer ?
pairs.en: How fast can we get started?

pairs.fr: Le Live Coach fonctionne en quelques minutes […] sans aucun travail manuel.
pairs.en: Live Coach works in minutes: the rep installs the app, starts a call and gets real-time coaching right away. Setup on your side takes about 5 minutes. By the end of week one, you see every call your team makes. After a month, Eagr delivers a complete playbook built from your team’s real conversations, with no manual work.

pairs.fr: Et si nous n'avons pas de playbook ?
pairs.en: What if we don’t have a playbook?

pairs.fr: Eagr en construit un à partir des vrais appels de votre équipe […] évoluer automatiquement.
pairs.en: Eagr builds one from your team’s real calls, based on what top performers actually do, not gut feel. After a month of calls, you get a structured playbook that keeps evolving on its own.

pairs.fr: Est-ce que ça fonctionne pour les équipes non anglophones ?
pairs.en: Does it work in other languages?

pairs.fr: Oui. Eagr prend en charge 8 langues, et l’IA analyse chaque conversation dans sa langue d’origine.
pairs.en: Yes. Eagr supports 8 languages and analyzes every conversation in its original language.

pairs.fr: Les commerciaux voient-ils les données des autres ?
pairs.en: Can reps see each other’s data?

pairs.fr: Non. Chaque commercial ne voit que ses propres performances. […] gérés par rôle.
pairs.en: No. Each rep only sees their own performance. Managers see individual and team-level data for their team. Access is role-based.

pairs.fr: Mes données sont-elles sécurisées ?
pairs.en: Is my data secure?

pairs.fr: Oui. Eagr est conforme au RGPD et à l’AI Act européen. Toutes les données sont chiffrées et hébergées dans l’Union européenne.
pairs.en: Yes. Eagr is GDPR and EU AI Act compliant. All data is encrypted and hosted in the EU.
